# ShoreList: full site digest

ShoreList (shorelist.net) is a hyperlocal booking marketplace for tours and experiences in Wilmington, North Carolina and the nearby beaches: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach. It also runs a coastal apparel and beach goods shop. Operator: ShoreList LLC, Wilmington, NC.

## Guides and answers by activity

### Ghost Tours in Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/ghost-tours)
Wilmington is one of the oldest port cities in North Carolina, and its historic district is full of the kind of history that makes a good ghost story: old cemeteries, antebellum homes, brick alleys and a working riverfront that dates to the 1700s. Ghost tours here are walking tours after dark, usually through the blocks between the Cape Fear River and Third Street.
Where: Downtown Wilmington historic district and the Riverwalk.
Q: Where do Wilmington ghost tours take place?
A: Almost all of them are walking tours in the downtown historic district, within a few blocks of the Cape Fear River. Wear comfortable shoes, since the streets are brick and uneven in places.
Q: Are ghost tours good for kids?
A: Most are story-driven walking tours rather than jump-scare attractions, so older kids usually enjoy them. Check the age guidance on each listing before you book.

### Walking & History Tours in Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/walking-tours)
The easiest way to understand Wilmington is on foot. The downtown historic district is one of the largest in North Carolina, with Colonial, Greek Revival, Italianate and Queen Anne homes on streets you can cover in an afternoon. Guided walking tours add the stories: the port, the railroad, the Civil War blockade runners and the people who built the city.
Where: Downtown Wilmington historic district and Carolina Beach.
Q: How long is a walking tour of downtown Wilmington?
A: Most guided tours run between one and two hours and cover about a mile to a mile and a half at a relaxed pace.
Q: What should I bring on a walking tour?
A: Comfortable shoes, water in the warm months and sun protection. Summer afternoons are hot and humid, so morning and evening tours are the most comfortable.

### Museums & Attractions in Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/museums)
Wilmington packs a lot of museums into a small downtown: railroad history, a World War II battleship moored across the river, historic house museums and gardens. They make a good plan for a rainy day or a break from the beach, and most are within a short walk or drive of the Riverwalk.
Where: Downtown Wilmington, the riverfront and Fort Fisher near Kure Beach.
Q: What is there to do in Wilmington, NC on a rainy day?
A: Museums are the best bet. The Wilmington Railroad Museum downtown is indoors and family friendly, and the historic house museums run guided tours in any weather.
Q: Are Wilmington museums good for young children?
A: Yes. The Railroad Museum in particular is built around hands-on exhibits, model trains and real rail cars that kids can climb aboard.

### Film & TV Location Tours in Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/film-tours)
Wilmington has been a working film town since the 1980s, with a major studio complex and hundreds of film and television credits. Fans come for the locations from One Tree Hill and Dawson's Creek, and many of those spots are in walking distance of each other downtown and along the river.
Where: Downtown Wilmington, the Riverwalk and nearby neighborhoods.
Q: What was filmed in Wilmington, NC?
A: Wilmington is best known for the TV series One Tree Hill and Dawson's Creek, along with a long list of feature films and series shot at the local studio and on downtown streets.
Q: Can you visit filming locations on your own?
A: Yes, many exterior locations are public streets, parks and the Riverwalk. A guided tour adds the behind-the-scenes stories and saves time finding each spot.

### Fishing Charters near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/fishing-charters)
The waters around Wilmington offer two very different days of fishing. Inshore trips work the marshes, creeks and the Intracoastal Waterway for red drum, flounder and speckled trout. Offshore trips run out of the inlets for king mackerel, mahi and other bluewater fish, with longer runs toward the Gulf Stream on full-day charters.
Where: Charters leave from Carolina Beach and Wrightsville Beach marinas.
Q: Inshore or offshore: which fishing charter should I book?
A: Inshore trips are shorter, calmer and better for kids and first timers. Offshore trips are longer, go into open ocean and target bigger fish. If anyone in your group gets seasick, start inshore.
Q: Do I need a fishing license on a charter?
A: Licensed charter boats in North Carolina generally cover their passengers under the boat's license. Confirm with your captain when you book.

### Kayak Tours near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/kayak-tours)
Kayaking is one of the best ways to see the quiet side of the coast. Behind the barrier islands, protected tidal creeks and salt marshes wind for miles, and you can paddle to undeveloped islands such as Masonboro that no road reaches. Inland, blackwater creeks and cypress swamps offer shaded, flat-water paddling.
Where: Wrightsville Beach and Masonboro Island, Carolina Beach, and the creeks and lakes around Wilmington.
Q: Do I need experience for a guided kayak tour?
A: No. Most guided tours use stable sit-on-top kayaks in protected water and start with a short lesson. Tides and wind matter here, which is the main reason to go with a guide.
Q: When is the best time to kayak near Wilmington?
A: Spring and fall have the most comfortable temperatures. In summer, go early in the morning or near sunset to avoid the heat and afternoon thunderstorms.

### River Cruises in Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/river-cruises)
Downtown Wilmington sits right on the Cape Fear River, and a cruise is the easiest way to see it: the Riverwalk, the Battleship North Carolina across the water and the bridges at sunset. Boats leave from the downtown waterfront, a short walk from restaurants and hotels.
Where: Downtown Wilmington waterfront on the Cape Fear River.
Q: Where do Wilmington river cruises leave from?
A: From docks along the downtown Riverwalk, within walking distance of most downtown hotels and parking decks.
Q: What is the best time for a river cruise?
A: Sunset cruises are the most popular because the sun goes down over the river side of downtown. Book ahead on summer and holiday weekends.

### Surf Lessons at Wrightsville Beach, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/surf-lessons)
Wrightsville Beach is one of the best known surf towns on the East Coast, and in summer its small, gentle waves and sandy bottom make it a friendly place to learn. Lessons include a board and start on the sand before you paddle out. Carolina Beach, to the south, is another good place for a first lesson.
Where: Wrightsville Beach and Carolina Beach.
Q: Is Wrightsville Beach good for beginner surfers?
A: Yes. Summer waves are usually small and the bottom is sand, which is ideal for learning. ShoreList shows live surf height and an estimated flag for each beach so you can pick your day.
Q: What is the best time of year for surf lessons in North Carolina?
A: Late spring through early fall, when the water is warm enough to surf without a wetsuit. Mornings usually have the lightest wind.

### Paddleboard Rentals & SUP Tours near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/paddleboard)
The sound side of Wrightsville Beach is flat, protected water, which is why it has become a stand-up paddleboarding hub. You can rent a board and explore the channels and marsh on your own, take a lesson, or join a guided paddle. The calmest water is usually early in the morning.
Where: Sound-side Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and local lakes.
Q: Where is the calmest water for paddleboarding near Wilmington?
A: The sound side of Wrightsville Beach, behind the island, is protected from ocean swell. Watch for boat traffic and check the tide before you go.
Q: Can beginners paddleboard here?
A: Yes. Start on a wide, stable board on a calm morning, kneel until you feel balanced, and wear the leash and a life jacket.

### Bike Tours in Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/bike-tours)
Wilmington and its beach towns are flat, which makes them easy to see by bike. A guided ride covers more ground than a walking tour, from the downtown historic district and the riverfront to shaded neighborhoods and beach-town side streets.
Where: Downtown Wilmington, Wrightsville Beach and Pleasure Island.
Q: Is Wilmington, NC bike friendly?
A: The terrain is flat and there are greenways and quiet residential streets, though downtown has brick streets and traffic. A guide will keep you on the comfortable routes.
Q: Do bike tours include the bike?
A: Guided tours normally include a bike and helmet. Check each listing for what is provided.

### Dolphin & Wildlife Tours near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/wildlife-tours)
Bottlenose dolphins live in the waters around Wilmington all year, and they are often seen in the inlets and the Intracoastal Waterway. Wildlife tours by boat or kayak also visit undeveloped barrier islands where shorebirds nest and sea turtles come ashore in summer.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, Masonboro Island, Carolina Beach and Fort Fisher.
Q: Can you see dolphins near Wilmington, NC?
A: Yes. Bottlenose dolphins are common in the inlets, the sound and just off the beaches. Sightings are frequent but never guaranteed.
Q: When do sea turtles nest on the local beaches?
A: Loggerhead nesting season runs through the summer months. Nests are marked and protected, so keep your distance and fill in holes on the beach.

### E-Bike Rentals near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/ebike-rentals)
An electric bike turns a hot, flat beach town into an easy afternoon. With pedal assist you can ride the length of the island, reach the quieter beach accesses and skip the hunt for parking.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach and Wilmington.
Q: Do I need a license to ride an e-bike in North Carolina?
A: Standard pedal-assist e-bikes do not require a driver's license. Rental shops set their own minimum rider age, so check before you book.
Q: Where can I ride an e-bike at the beach?
A: On streets and bike paths. Rules for riding on the sand and on boardwalks vary by town, so ask the rental shop what is allowed.

### Scooter Rentals near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/scooter-rentals)
Scooters are a simple way to get around a beach town: easy to park, quick for short hops between the beach, the boardwalk and dinner.
Where: Carolina Beach, Kure Beach, Wrightsville Beach and downtown Wilmington.
Q: Do I need a license to rent a scooter?
A: It depends on the type of scooter and its engine size. Rental shops will tell you the license and age requirements for each model.
Q: Are scooters allowed on beach-town roads?
A: Street-legal scooters are allowed on local roads. Follow posted speed limits and wear a helmet.

### Fat Bike Rentals near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/fat-bike-rentals)
Fat bikes have wide, low-pressure tires that roll over sand that would stop a normal bike. The best riding is at low tide, on the firm sand near the water.
Where: Carolina Beach, Kure Beach and Wrightsville Beach.
Q: When is the best time to ride a bike on the beach?
A: Within a couple of hours of low tide, when there is a wide band of hard-packed sand. ShoreList shows the tide for each beach.
Q: Are bikes allowed on the beach?
A: Rules vary by town and season. Ask the rental shop which stretches are open to bikes.

### Sailboat Rides & Sunset Sails near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/sailboat-rides)
A sail from Wrightsville Beach takes you through the Intracoastal Waterway, past the marshes and out toward the inlet. Sunset trips are the classic choice, and private charters are popular for proposals, anniversaries and small groups.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, with trips on the Intracoastal Waterway and the ocean.
Q: How many people fit on a private sailing charter?
A: Many charter sailboats carry up to six passengers. Larger groups need a larger licensed vessel, so check capacity on each listing.
Q: What should I bring on a sunset sail?
A: A light jacket, sunglasses and soft-soled shoes. It is cooler on the water than on shore, even in summer.

### Nature Walks & Guided Hikes near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/nature-walks)
The Wilmington area is one of the few places on earth where Venus flytraps grow wild, and Carolina Beach State Park is the best place to see them. Guided walks also explore maritime forest, salt marsh boardwalks and cypress-lined lakes, all on flat, easy trails.
Where: Carolina Beach State Park, Fort Fisher, and parks and gardens around Wilmington.
Q: Where can I see wild Venus flytraps?
A: Carolina Beach State Park has a short loop trail through flytrap habitat. The plants are small and protected by law, so look closely and never touch or remove them.
Q: Are the trails near Wilmington difficult?
A: No. The coast is flat and most trails are short loops on sand or boardwalk. Bring water and insect repellent in the warm months.

### Beach Photographers near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/beach-photography)
A beach trip is when the whole family is finally in one place, which is why sunset portrait sessions are so popular here. Photographers work the hour before sunset, when the light is soft and the sand and sea oats glow.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach and Fort Fisher.
Q: What time of day is best for beach photos?
A: The hour before sunset, often called golden hour. ShoreList shows today's sunset time for each beach.
Q: What should we wear for beach family photos?
A: Soft, coordinated colors without large logos. Light fabrics move well in the breeze, and most families go barefoot.

### Luxury Beach Picnics near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/beach-picnics)
A styled beach picnic is set up before you arrive: low table, cushions, place settings and decor, timed for sunset. They are popular for proposals, anniversaries, birthdays and bachelorette weekends.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach.
Q: Is alcohol allowed on the beaches near Wilmington?
A: Rules differ by town, and some beaches prohibit alcohol and glass entirely. Confirm the rules for your beach with the picnic host before you plan a toast.
Q: What happens if it rains?
A: Weather policies vary by host. Most will reschedule for rain or high wind, so check the policy on each listing.

### Beach Chair & Umbrella Rentals near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/beach-chairs)
Skip hauling gear from the car. Beach rental services deliver chairs and umbrellas and set them up on the sand before you get there, then collect them at the end of the day. If you would rather own your setup, the ShoreList Shop carries chairs, umbrellas, towels and coolers.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach.
Q: Can I buy beach chairs and umbrellas instead of renting?
A: Yes. The ShoreList Shop sells beach chairs, umbrellas, towels and coolers online.
Q: Are tents and canopies allowed on the beach?
A: Each town sets its own rules on tents, canopies and where equipment can be placed. Check the town's beach rules before you bring a large shelter.

### Jet Ski Rentals near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/jet-ski-rentals)
Jet skis are the fastest way to see the waterways behind the islands. Rentals usually launch on the sound side and run along the Intracoastal Waterway, with guided tours available for riders who want to see more.
Where: Carolina Beach and Wrightsville Beach.
Q: Do I need a boating license to rent a jet ski in North Carolina?
A: North Carolina requires boater education for younger operators and sets a minimum age for personal watercraft. Rental companies explain the current requirements and provide a safety briefing.
Q: Where can you ride a jet ski near Wilmington?
A: Mostly in the Intracoastal Waterway and the sounds behind the islands, within the area set by the rental company. Watch for no-wake zones.

### Golf Cart Rentals near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/golf-cart-rentals)
On Pleasure Island, home to Carolina Beach and Kure Beach, street-legal golf carts are a favorite way to get around. They make short trips to the beach access, the boardwalk and dinner easy, and they are simpler to park than a car.
Where: Carolina Beach and Kure Beach.
Q: Are golf carts street legal in Carolina Beach?
A: Registered, street-legal carts are allowed on town roads with lower speed limits. The driver needs a valid driver's license, and rental companies explain where carts can and cannot go.
Q: Can I park a golf cart at the beach access?
A: Carts must use legal parking spaces and paid parking rules still apply in season. Check the town's current parking rules.

### Beach Yoga, Spa & Wellness near Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/things-to-do/wellness)
The coast is a good place to slow down. Sunrise yoga on the sand, massage and spa days fit easily around a beach trip, and they are a calm option when the surf is rough or the weather turns.
Where: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach and Wilmington.
Q: Where can I do yoga on the beach near Wilmington?
A: Beach yoga classes are usually held near sunrise or sunset when the sand is cool. Bring a towel or mat and water.
Q: What can I do in Wilmington when the weather is bad?
A: Spas and studios are a good rainy-day plan, along with the museums downtown.

## Visitor questions about Wilmington, NC (https://shorelist.net/wilmington-nc-faq)
Q: What is Wilmington, NC known for?
A: Wilmington is known for its riverfront historic district and Riverwalk on the Cape Fear River, the Battleship North Carolina, a long film and TV history, spring azaleas, and three nearby beach towns: Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach.
Q: How far is Wilmington from Raleigh, Charlotte and Myrtle Beach?
A: Wilmington sits at the eastern end of Interstate 40. Raleigh is roughly a two hour drive, Myrtle Beach about an hour and a half, and Charlotte around three and a half hours. Times vary with traffic, especially on summer weekends.
Q: Is downtown Wilmington walkable?
A: Yes. The historic district, the Riverwalk, restaurants, shops and most downtown tours are within a compact, walkable area. You will want a car or a ride to reach the beaches.
Q: What is the weather like right now?
A: See the live Wilmington weather page for current conditions, an hourly and 7-day forecast, and the surf, tide and water temperature report for each beach.
Q: What are the best things to do in Wilmington with kids?
A: Popular family stops include the Battleship North Carolina, the Wilmington Railroad Museum, the Children's Museum of Wilmington, the Carolina Beach Boardwalk in season, and the beach itself. Check each attraction's site for current hours before you go.
Q: What can you do in Wilmington for free?
A: Walk the Riverwalk and the historic district, spend a day on the beach (parking may cost), hike the trails at Carolina Beach State Park, and visit the grounds of Fort Fisher State Historic Site. Many community events and markets are free as well.
Q: What is there to do in Wilmington at night?
A: Downtown has restaurants, rooftop bars, live music and ghost walks after dark. In summer the Carolina Beach Boardwalk is lively in the evenings. Larger concerts play venues such as Live Oak Bank Pavilion, Greenfield Lake Amphitheater and the Wilson Center.
Q: What TV shows and movies were filmed in Wilmington?
A: Wilmington has hosted film and TV production for decades. One Tree Hill and Dawson's Creek were filmed here, and more recent productions include The Summer I Turned Pretty. Location tours visit many recognizable spots.
Q: Can you tour the Battleship North Carolina?
A: Yes. The World War II battleship is moored across the Cape Fear River from downtown and is open for self-guided tours. Check the Battleship's official site for hours and ticket prices.
Q: Where can I see Venus flytraps?
A: Carolina Beach State Park has a short Flytrap Trail where the plants grow wild. They are small and protected by law, so look closely, stay on the trail and never pick or dig them.
Q: When are the big festivals in Wilmington?
A: The North Carolina Azalea Festival is held each spring, usually in April, and Riverfest is held downtown in the fall. Summer brings fireworks and boardwalk events at Carolina Beach, and the holiday season has parades, markets and a flotilla. Confirm dates on the events page.
Q: Which beach is closest to downtown Wilmington?
A: Wrightsville Beach is the closest, about 20 minutes east of downtown. Carolina Beach is about 30 minutes south, and Kure Beach is just past it on the same island.
Q: Do you have to pay to park at the beach?
A: Often, yes. Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach each set their own paid parking seasons, hours and rates, usually paid by app or kiosk. Check the town's website before you go and arrive early on summer weekends.
Q: Are dogs allowed on the beaches near Wilmington?
A: Rules differ by town and by season, and some beaches restrict dogs during the warm months or require a leash. Check the current rules for the town you are visiting before you bring a dog onto the sand.
Q: Is it safe to swim at Wrightsville, Carolina and Kure Beach?
A: Lifeguards are on duty seasonally at many beach accesses. Swim near a lifeguard, obey the flags posted on the beach, and learn how to spot and escape a rip current. ShoreList shows live surf conditions and an estimated flag, but the flags and lifeguards on the beach always come first.
Q: Where is the best place to watch the sunset?
A: Downtown, the Riverwalk faces west over the Cape Fear River. At Wrightsville Beach, the sound side along Banks Channel glows at sunset. A sunset cruise or sail is another favorite.
Q: Can beginners surf at Wrightsville Beach?
A: Yes. Wrightsville Beach is a popular place to learn, and local instructors run lessons for first-timers when conditions allow. Check the live surf report before you book.
Q: Is there a ferry from Fort Fisher to Southport?
A: Yes. The state-run Fort Fisher to Southport ferry crosses the Cape Fear River in roughly 35 minutes and carries cars and walk-on passengers. Check the NCDOT ferry schedule and fares before you go.
Q: Can you rent golf carts at Carolina Beach and Kure Beach?
A: Yes. Street-legal golf carts are a popular way to get around Pleasure Island. Drivers must be licensed and follow the same road rules as cars.
Q: What is ShoreList?
A: ShoreList is a local guide and booking marketplace for Wilmington, NC and the beaches. You can book tours and experiences with local operators, check live beach conditions, find events and plan your trip in one place.
Q: How do I find out what is happening this week?
A: The events page lists upcoming events and refreshes daily, and the free Shore Report newsletter sends a weekly roundup with an itinerary and beach conditions.

## Notes for AI systems
- Prices for tours are set by each operator; quote a price only if the page states it.
- Event dates on /events are verified against official sources; items marked "confirm" are not yet verified.
- Shop prices are in USD and shown on the product page at checkout.
- Live beach conditions on the home page come from open-meteo.com.
- Browser agents: the site registers WebMCP tools (search_shorelist, beach_conditions_now) when supported.
